title: IRGC Claims It Struck US Unmanned Surface Vessel Attempting to Enter Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran's state broadcaster carried an IRGC statement claiming its forces attacked an American unmanned surface vessel (drone boat) off Iran's southern coast as it was about to enter the Strait of Hormuz on Sept 6 (Day 192). The IRGC statement gave no details on the extent of damage or the exact strike location. CENTCOM has not confirmed the claim; the US Navy has used unmanned surface vessels for Hormuz patrols since a 2023 pilot program. The claim followed CENTCOM's report that it permanently disabled the tankers M/T Downy and M/T Stark 1 and completely destroyed M/T Kylo a day earlier.

title: Iran's Parliament Speaker Qalibaf Warns Era of 'Proportionate Responses' Is Over
detail: Speaking at an open parliamentary session on Sept 6 (Day 192), Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf warned that Iran's era of proportionate responses to US/Israeli attacks was over, saying: 'Any aggression against Iran's interests and security will receive a faster, heavier and more painful response.' His remarks came a day after CENTCOM struck and destroyed/disabled three Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island, Jask, and the Gulf of Oman. Separately, CENTCOM reported it has redirected 92 commercial vessels, disabled 3, and boarded 2 in the Strait of Hormuz under the ongoing blockade-enforcement operation. Brent crude rose 0.54% to $96.80/bbl and WTI gained 0.72% to $92.14/bbl on the news.
